clock_reset.WINDOW_mux_KARB: clk with asynchronous negedge rst_n/rn state reset
clock_reset.architecture_clock_policy: AGENTS declares streaming1.2GHz and serial0.9GHz; these are target domains, not a measured closure or CDC implementation in this runtime manifest
clock_reset.backend: same connected clk interface, synchronous !rst_n queue/return reset on posedge
clock_reset.connected_fixture: CLK_PS1000 and one 1ns simulated clock, not physical qualification
clock_reset.live_reset_scope: rn fans out across die/core, all four stacks and other services. A WINDOW-only certificate cannot authorize rn reset; require all reset-domain producers/queues/engines and W/B/CKV/RoPE ownership drained.
clock_reset.phy: runtime u_hbm uses clk/rn; K model u_k uses rst_n and defaults CLK_PS1000; wrapper does not forward CLK_PS to u_k
clock_reset.root_reset: rst_n asynchronous assertion into two-flop rst_s, rn=rst_s[1], two posedges for release
clock_reset.runtime_die: One clk input in pinned runtime source; no mesochronous crossings modeled (source lines49-50)

counter_rules: reserve counts before request publication; reserve may be cancelled only before any accepting boundary
atomic accept at actual direct mux/KARB/backend handshake transfers lease; optional PIPE_OUT accept creates KARB-held lease
accept-retire equals accepted owned leases; reserve-cancel-retire equals all leases
fault latches existing fault bits and freezes ingress; it does not free reservations, reset epoch or clear accepted counters
retire only exact typed identity after final return handshake; rejected stale/duplicate cannot retire a new owner
restart/epoch reset requires all actor acknowledgements tied to current lease/revision and end-to-end delivery fence
64-bit ticket/lease/revision exhaustion refuses further reuse; observer trace is not hardware storage
finite_ownership.held_registered_response: aliases RQ head, not a ninth lease

interface_state_route_cost.alternative_full_serial_on_wire_cost: If no fence guarantee is obtainable, adding serial64 would add4096 aggregate request+response tag bits across32PCs per stack (16384 across4stacks), before mux fanout. Not proposed/implemented/adopted; finite serial also fails closed on exhaustion.
interface_state_route_cost.boundary: Any future hardware change must be priced in tools/uarch_model.py and routing/SSFF gates before build; this task creates only the protocol specification.
interface_state_route_cost.cost_class: analytical state/route count only; no synthesis/area/SSFF/track measurement
interface_state_route_cost.existing_wire_tags: 14 WINDOW payload bits +2 mux-owner bits; KARB adds one bit ->17 backend tag bits; unchanged by this spec
interface_state_route_cost.minimum_future_control_routes: 5 acknowledged-empty/fence actor signals plus freeze/recover_request/epoch_clear/reset_permission:9 control signals for selected owner; each tied to lease/fenced transaction, not bare pulses
interface_state_route_cost.minimum_wire_tag_comparators: 8 x14-bit equal comparisons, plus valid/phase/lease checks; physical optimization not qualified

latency.already_eligible_held_no_competitors: At most8 WINDOW response handshakes at one K return per cycle, plus one registered-offer clear edge, plus explicit ack/clear control latency. This is a conditional service-count bound, not a calendar/PPA measurement.
latency.future_control_assumption: If acknowledgements sampled in parallel on common clk, 1 registration +1 commit +1 restart edge =3 proposed control cycles; not implemented, no throughput/clock credit.
latency.queued_reads: Requires existing finite backend event calendar and fairness assumptions; no new calendar/provider is introduced or tuned here.
latency.under_arbitrary_held_response: No finite recovery latency bound; restart remains denied until actual handshake/fence. Timeout never releases ownership.

minimum_future_opt_in_preconditions: Exact source/parameter pins and common-clock reset bindings; direct KARB selection fixed. Any PIPE_RSP/KARB_LOCAL change extends the gate before admission
Bind five named provider acknowledgements above to implemented exact signals/counters; their current absence is the concrete admission blocker
Freeze every selected-owner ingress on fault, including same-edge accepted grants, prime and block publication; latch original fault until certified clear
Account all owned leases through queued, scheduled, return-queued and registered held stages; held-ready can stall indefinitely without credit reclamation
Quarantine staging/retained publication on fault; re-prime/revalidate source content after certified restart; do not assume old stage_valid survives
Provider fence guarantees no future old-generation callbacks/responses; otherwise bounded epoch alias cannot be admitted
No source-only/global forced reset while ownership exists; die rn reset additionally needs global reset-domain drain certificate
Fail closed on counter exhaustion, invalid/late ack, missing provider or timeout; retain original fault and all leases; no timeout-based cancellation

providers.missing: WINDOW_RECOVERY_RETIRE_ACK(lease,ticket,outcome) plus frozen accepted/cancelled/retired counters; current fault guard prevents bookkeeping retirement
providers.requirement: Freeze prefetch/prime/blk/start; preserve accepted leases and fault; independently discard-and-retire valid fault-drain responses; cancel only never-accepted reservations

implemented: combinational WINDOW/CKV/RoPE ownership tags and routing
providers.requirement: No ledger in mux. With direct paths, prove no local storage and prevent upstream reissue; retain owner tags through drain, never infer global idle from w_v=0

Read leases must span accepted request through WINDOW retirement; grant counter or write-zero alone is not read drain. PIPE_OUT1 optional held-request modeled; PIPE_RSP1 requires additional held-group acknowledgement and is outside executable direct-return model

implemented: registered return handshake and bounded QD64/RQD32
providers.requirement: RQ-held registered offer aliases its RQ-head identity; do not double-count it, but require its valid clears after final acceptance edge. Shared queues require all-owner global drain or reliable owner-scoped ledger, not simply WINDOW pending=0

implemented: closed synthetic timed backend emits one registered response per accepted read in nominal path
providers.missing: DELIVERY_FENCE_ACK(lease,no future stale/duplicate response from any route/provider)
providers.requirement: Cannot infer from 9-bit tag, timer, quiet samples or reset. Must bind exact transport/provider source and stop all request ingress; if arbitrary late duplicates remain possible, refuse restart or carry a nonaliasing identity end-to-end. MODEL_ONLY certificates never authorize RTL.

scope: One selected-stack WINDOW read owner, credits<=8, LENW4/BEATW4, 9-bit epoch, direct mux/KARB and registered backend returns. Event-level reservation/ownership protocol, not a replacement timing/backend/hardware model.
